qa_pairs.interviewer_question: Explain the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases.
qa_pairs.candidate_answer: SQL databases are relational and use structured schemas with ACID properties, while NoSQL databases are more flexible, schema-less, and designed for horizontal scaling. SQL is better for complex queries and transactions, NoSQL excels at handling large volumes of unstructured data.
